selection_rule: Retain candidates whose mean clean chronological-validation F1 is within 0.02 of the clean-trained logistic-regression primary reference. Among eligible candidates for each representation, maximize the equally weighted mean of clean F1 and mean F1 across all configured whole-validation-period Light faults; break ties with higher clean F1, lower augmentation ratio, then model name. If no candidate satisfies the guardrail, retain the highest-clean-F1 candidate for diagnostic held-out comparison and mark the guardrail as unsatisfied; it is not an accepted replacement.
augmentation_note: Each development fold retains all clean rows and adds a fault-augmented sample equal to 1%, 5%, or 10% of the clean row count. Added rows are divided equally among configured Light faults. Missing Light is replaced with the development-fold median after a missingness flag is calculated. Augmentation strength and model algorithm are selected inside chronological training validation.
